notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Relm's Sketching
description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Relm's Sketching, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
